title: Conquering the Water 150503-M-TA826-001
description: Marines with II Marine Headquarters Group participated in a bi-annual swim qualifications at Area 5 pool aboard Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, N.C., on March 5, 2015. The qualification includes a 4 minute water tread and a self-rescue from an 8-foot platform. One Marine in particular struggled to overcome a fear of heights in order to qualify. Produced by Cpl. Kirstin Merrimarahajara. Includes soundbites from Cpl. Yahenys Dominguez, warehouse clerk, II MHG, and Sgt. Austin Long, Marine Combat Instructor of Water Survival, II Marine Expeditionary Force Public Affairs Office.

transcript.text: The hottest part for me was the jump, just to see the water and the high makes me scared.
I've always had a passion for swimming and for just being in the water.
I have a passion for helping people and I want to see other people succeed, especially
We conducted the swim qualification basic.
A lot of things that the Marines struggle with on basic is the self-rescue.
And that's where you come up to the tower between 8 to 10 feet.
You step up to the edge, you hang 10 and then you get to take that 130-inch step.
It feels good to actually just jump and do it.
And that's the Marine Corps about accomplishing great feats.
I will do it tomorrow again.
